script_text: Stop, Pisces — Neptune, your ruling planet and the element of water itself, is burning through your sign right now and it's rewriting everything. The Sun opposes Neptune in your 12th House of the Unseen, casting a heavy fog over hidden finances and buried secrets you've been ignoring. Mercury moves through Virgo in that same 12th House, so buried truths demand to surface today. In love, if you're single, a mysterious connection arrives through a mutual friend — trust the pull even when logic fails you. If taken, don't suppress resentment; it surfaces under this Neptune haze. Your 6th House of daily work activates hard — a colleague hands you extra responsibility around midday. Don't overcommit just to be the hero. Avoid signing contracts before noon; Mercury opposes Neptune and the fine print will betray you. Follow for tomorrow's reading — the Moon shifts into your sign and everything changes.
